note_sections.t: Re-evaluation for prior low-grade prostate cancer with rising PSA.

Recently retired harbour pilot (semi-retired) with a history of prostate adenocarcinoma diagnosed on biopsy in June 2024. PSA has fluctuated significantly, reaching 6.9 ng/mL in February 2025. Patient lives alone, divorced, with brother as next of kin. Reports moderate LUTS (IPSS 10). Drinks 24 units of alcohol weekly, exercises with light weight-training twice weekly. Lives over 90 minutes from clinic, prefers phone follow-up. Recent dermatology visit for actinic keratosis. No active medications, non-smoker.
On DRE, a suspicious nodule is palpable in the mid right peripheral zone, consistent with cT1c staging. General examination is unremarkable, with normal vital signs and no lymphadenopathy.

admin: Lives >90 min from clinic; phone follow-up preferred where clinically safe.
